If no. 597 is that 19 Jan 1642 cipher letter (Racz returned it unread) it has a printed plaintext and would be read, not open; Lang's 'nincs feltorve' is not evidence against that. Unblock: an image of no. 597 from MNL OL to compare with Szilagyi pp. 667-668 (clavis and wording).
